review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Manage Dell PowerEdge servers, Windows Server and Microsoft Hyper-V Failover Clusters, including health monitoring, capacity, patching, firmware, upgrades and fault resolution. Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, replication and domain services. Administer Dell and HPE Aruba switching and wireless infrastructure. Maintain technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer across the IT team.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on senior technical role combining infrastructure operations, Level 3 support, security, cloud services and project delivery. About You You will bring strong hands-on experience across: Windows Server & Hyper-V Failover Clustering Active Directory, GPO, DNS & DHCP Microsoft 365, Azure & Entra ID Intune & Windows Autopilot Fortinet / FortiGate Dell PowerEdge HPE Aruba networking & wireless Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Experience with Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Purview, PowerShell, infrastructure automation or HPE GreenLake will be highly regarded.
